verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ אִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nū haš·šā·ma·yim wa·’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh wə·ṯiš·ma‘ hā·’ā·reṣ ’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: Give ear O heavens and I will speak hear O earth the words of my mouth

verses.original: יַעֲרֹ֤ף כַּמָּטָר֙ לִקְחִ֔י תִּזַּ֥ל כַּטַּ֖ל אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּשְׂעִירִ֣ם עֲלֵי־ דֶ֔שֶׁא וְכִרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·rōp̄ kam·mā·ṭār liq·ḥî tiz·zal kaṭ·ṭal ’im·rā·ṯî kiś·‘î·rim ‘ă·lê- ḏe·še wə·ḵir·ḇî·ḇîm ‘ă·lê- ‘ê·śeḇ
verses.literal: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew like gentle rain on new grass like showers on tender plants

verses.original: כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א הָב֥וּ גֹ֖דֶל לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî šêm Yah·weh ’eq·rā hā·ḇū ḡō·ḏel lê·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD Ascribe greatness to our God

verses.original: הַצּוּר֙ תָּמִ֣ים פָּעֳל֔וֹ כִּ֥י כָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אֵ֤ל אֱמוּנָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין עָ֔וֶל צַדִּ֥יק וְיָשָׁ֖ר הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: haṣ·ṣūr tā·mîm pā·‘o·lōw kî ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw miš·pāṭ ’êl ’ĕ·mū·nāh wə·’ên ‘ā·wel ṣad·dîq wə·yā·šār hū
verses.literal: He is the Rock His work . . . is perfect all His ways are just A God of faithfulness without injustice righteous and upright is He

verses.original: שִׁחֵ֥ת ל֛וֹ לֹ֖א בָּנָ֣יו מוּמָ֑ם דּ֥וֹר עִקֵּ֖שׁ וּפְתַלְתֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ši·ḥêṯ lōw lō bā·nāw mū·mām dō·wr ‘iq·qêš ū·p̄ə·ṯal·tōl
verses.literal: His people have acted corruptly toward Him the blemish on them is not that of His children but of a perverse and crooked generation

verses.original: הֲ־ לַיְהוָה֙ תִּגְמְלוּ־ זֹ֔את עַ֥ם נָבָ֖ל וְלֹ֣א חָכָ֑ם הֲלוֹא־ הוּא֙ אָבִ֣יךָ קָּנֶ֔ךָ ה֥וּא עָֽשְׂךָ֖ וַֽיְכֹנְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă- Yah·weh tiḡ·mə·lū- zōṯ ‘am nā·ḇāl wə·lō ḥā·ḵām hă·lō·w- hū ’ā·ḇî·ḵā qā·ne·ḵā hū ‘ā·śə·ḵā way·ḵō·nə·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Is this how you repay the LORD O foolish and senseless . . . people Is He not your Father and Creator Has He not made you and established you

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ יְמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם בִּ֖ינוּ שְׁנ֣וֹת דּוֹר־ וָד֑וֹר שְׁאַ֤ל אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְיַגֵּ֔דְךָ זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְיֹ֥אמְרוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr yə·mō·wṯ ‘ō·w·lām bî·nū šə·nō·wṯ dō·wr- wā·ḏō·wr šə·’al ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·yag·gê·ḏə·ḵā zə·qê·ne·ḵā wə·yō·mə·rū lāḵ
verses.literal: Remember the days of old consider the years long past Ask your father and he will tell you your elders and they will inform you

verses.original: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·han·ḥêl ‘el·yō·wn gō·w·yim bə·hap̄·rî·ḏōw bə·nê ’ā·ḏām yaṣ·ṣêḇ gə·ḇu·lōṯ ‘am·mîm lə·mis·par bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance when He divided the sons of man He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֵ֥לֶק יְהֹוָ֖ה עַמּ֑וֹ יַעֲקֹ֖ב חֶ֥בֶל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥê·leq Yah·weh ‘am·mōw ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḥe·ḇel na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But the LORD’s portion is His people Jacob His allotted inheritance

verses.original: יִמְצָאֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִדְבָּ֔ר וּבְתֹ֖הוּ יְלֵ֣ל יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְסֹֽבְבֶ֙נְהוּ֙ יְב֣וֹנְנֵ֔הוּ יִצְּרֶ֖נְהוּ כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yim·ṣā·’ê·hū bə·’e·reṣ miḏ·bār ū·ḇə·ṯō·hū yə·lêl yə·ši·mōn yə·sō·ḇə·ḇen·hū yə·ḇō·wn·nê·hū yiṣ·ṣə·ren·hū kə·’î·šō·wn ‘ê·nōw
verses.literal: He found him in a desert land in a barren howling wilderness He surrounded him He instructed him He guarded him as the apple of His eye

verses.original: כְּנֶ֙שֶׁר֙ יָעִ֣יר קִנּ֔וֹ עַל־ גּוֹזָלָ֖יו יְרַחֵ֑ף יִפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפָיו֙ יִקָּחֵ֔הוּ יִשָּׂאֵ֖הוּ עַל־ אֶבְרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ne·šer yā·‘îr qin·nōw ‘al- gō·w·zā·lāw yə·ra·ḥêp̄ yip̄·rōś kə·nā·p̄āw yiq·qā·ḥê·hū yiś·śā·’ê·hū ‘al- ’eḇ·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה בָּדָ֣ד יַנְחֶ֑נּוּ וְאֵ֥ין עִמּ֖וֹ אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bā·ḏāḏ yan·ḥen·nū wə·’ên ‘im·mōw ’êl nê·ḵār
verses.literal: The LORD alone led him and no foreign god was with him

verses.original: יַרְכִּבֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ בָּמוֹתֵי אָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַיֵּנִקֵ֤הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע וְשֶׁ֖מֶן מֵחַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: yar·ki·ḇê·hū ‘al- bå̄·mō·ṯē ’ā·reṣ way·yō·ḵal tə·nū·ḇōṯ śā·ḏāy way·yê·ni·qê·hū ḏə·ḇaš mis·se·la‘ wə·še·men mê·ḥal·mîš ṣūr
verses.literal: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag

verses.original: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַחֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם־ חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְאֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־ בָשָׁן֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם־ חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְדַם־ עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה־ חָֽמֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥem·’aṯ bā·qār wa·ḥă·lêḇ ṣōn ‘im- ḥê·leḇ kā·rîm wə·’ê·lîm bə·nê- ḇā·šān wə·‘at·tū·ḏîm ‘im- ḥê·leḇ kil·yō·wṯ ḥiṭ·ṭāh wə·ḏam- ‘ê·nāḇ tiš·teh- ḥā·mer
verses.literal: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock with the fat of lambs with rams from Bashan . . . and goats with the choicest grains of wheat From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ן יְשֻׁרוּן֙ וַיִּבְעָ֔ט שָׁמַ֖נְתָּ עָבִ֣יתָ כָּשִׂ֑יתָ וַיִּטֹּשׁ֙ אֱל֣וֹהַ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וַיְנַבֵּ֖ל צ֥וּר יְשֻׁעָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·man yə·šu·rūn way·yiḇ·‘āṭ šā·man·tā ‘ā·ḇî·ṯā kā·śî·ṯā way·yiṭ·ṭōš ’ĕ·lō·w·ha ‘ā·śā·hū way·nab·bêl ṣūr yə·šu·‘ā·ṯōw
verses.literal: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked becoming fat bloated and gorged He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation

verses.original: יַקְנִאֻ֖הוּ בְּזָרִ֑ים בְּתוֹעֵבֹ֖ת יַכְעִיסֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yaq·ni·’u·hū bə·zā·rîm bə·ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ yaḵ·‘î·su·hū
verses.literal: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods they enraged Him with abominations

verses.original: יִזְבְּח֗וּ לַשֵּׁדִים֙ לֹ֣א אֱלֹ֔הַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְדָע֑וּם חֲדָשִׁים֙ מִקָּרֹ֣ב בָּ֔אוּ לֹ֥א שְׂעָר֖וּם אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·bə·ḥū laš·šê·ḏîm lō ’ĕ·lō·ha ’ĕ·lō·hîm lō yə·ḏā·‘ūm ḥă·ḏā·šîm miq·qā·rōḇ bā·’ū lō śə·‘ā·rūm ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: They sacrificed to demons not to God to gods they had not known to newly arrived gods . . . . . . which your fathers did not fear

verses.original: צ֥וּר יְלָדְךָ֖ תֶּ֑שִׁי וַתִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֵ֥ל מְחֹלְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣūr yə·lā·ḏə·ḵā te·šî wat·tiš·kaḥ ’êl mə·ḥō·lə·le·ḵā
verses.literal: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth you forgot the God who gave you birth

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּנְאָ֑ץ מִכַּ֥עַס בָּנָ֖יו וּבְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar Yah·weh way·yin·’āṣ mik·ka·‘as bā·nāw ū·ḇə·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: When the LORD saw this He rejected them provoked to anger by His sons and daughters

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַסְתִּ֤ירָה פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם אֶרְאֶ֖ה מָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֑ם כִּ֣י ד֤וֹר תַּהְפֻּכֹת֙ הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹא־ אֵמֻ֥ן בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’as·tî·rāh p̄ā·nay mê·hem ’er·’eh māh ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯām kî ḏō·wr tah·pu·ḵōṯ hêm·māh bā·nîm lō- ’ê·mun bām
verses.literal: He said I will hide My face from them I will see what will be their end For they are a perverse . . . generation children of unfaithfulness

verses.original: הֵ֚ם קִנְא֣וּנִי בְלֹא־ אֵ֔ל כִּעֲס֖וּנִי בְּהַבְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲנִי֙ אַקְנִיאֵ֣ם בְּלֹא־ עָ֔ם בְּג֥וֹי נָבָ֖ל אַכְעִיסֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hêm qin·’ū·nî ḇə·lō- ’êl ki·‘ă·sū·nî bə·haḇ·lê·hem wa·’ă·nî ’aq·nî·’êm bə·lō- ‘ām bə·ḡō·w nā·ḇāl ’aḵ·‘î·sêm
verses.literal: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God they have enraged Me with their worthless idols So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people I will make them angry by a nation without understanding

verses.original: כִּי־ אֵשׁ֙ קָדְחָ֣ה בְאַפִּ֔י וַתִּיקַ֖ד עַד־ שְׁא֣וֹל תַּחְתִּ֑ית וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וִֽיבֻלָ֔הּ וַתְּלַהֵ֖ט מוֹסְדֵ֥י הָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’êš qā·ḏə·ḥāh ḇə·’ap·pî wat·tî·qaḏ ‘aḏ- šə·’ō·wl taḥ·tîṯ wat·tō·ḵal ’e·reṣ wî·ḇu·lāh wat·tə·la·hêṭ mō·ws·ḏê hā·rîm
verses.literal: For a fire has been kindled by My anger and it burns to the depths of Sheol it consumes the earth and its produce and scorches the foundations of the mountains

verses.original: אַסְפֶּ֥ה עָלֵ֖ימוֹ רָע֑וֹת חִצַּ֖י אֲכַלֶּה־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’as·peh ‘ā·lê·mōw rā·‘ō·wṯ ḥiṣ·ṣay ’ă·ḵal·leh- bām
verses.literal: I will heap disasters upon them I will spend My arrows against them

verses.original: מְזֵ֥י רָעָ֛ב וּלְחֻ֥מֵי רֶ֖שֶׁף וְקֶ֣טֶב מְרִירִ֑י וְשֶׁן־ בְּהֵמוֹת֙ אֲשַׁלַּח־ בָּ֔ם עִם־ חֲמַ֖ת זֹחֲלֵ֥י עָפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mə·zê rā·‘āḇ ū·lə·ḥu·mê re·šep̄ wə·qe·ṭeḇ mə·rî·rî wə·šen- bə·hê·mō·wṯ ’ă·šal·laḥ- bām ‘im- ḥă·maṯ zō·ḥă·lê ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust

verses.original: מִחוּץ֙ תְּשַׁכֶּל־ חֶ֔רֶב וּמֵחֲדָרִ֖ים אֵימָ֑ה גַּם־ בָּחוּר֙ גַּם־ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יוֹנֵ֖ק עִם־ אִ֥ישׁ שֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mi·ḥūṣ tə·šak·kel- ḥe·reḇ ū·mê·ḥă·ḏā·rîm ’ê·māh gam- bā·ḥūr gam- bə·ṯū·lāh yō·w·nêq ‘im- ’îš śê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Outside the sword will take their children and inside terror will strike the young man . . . and the young woman the infant and the gray-haired man

verses.original: אָמַ֖רְתִּי אַפְאֵיהֶ֑ם אַשְׁבִּ֥יתָה מֵאֱנ֖וֹשׁ זִכְרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar·tî ’ap̄·’ê·hem ’aš·bî·ṯāh mê·’ĕ·nō·wōš ziḵ·rām
verses.literal: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind

verses.original: לוּלֵ֗י כַּ֤עַס אוֹיֵב֙ אָג֔וּר פֶּֽן־ יְנַכְּר֖וּ צָרֵ֑ימוֹ פֶּן־ יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ יָדֵ֣ינוּ רָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה פָּעַ֥ל כָּל־ זֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: lū·lê ka·‘as ’ō·w·yêḇ ’ā·ḡūr pen- yə·nak·kə·rū ṣā·rê·mōw pen- yō·mə·rū yā·ḏê·nū rā·māh wə·lō Yah·weh pā·‘al kāl- zōṯ
verses.literal: if I had not dreaded . . . the taunt of the enemy lest their adversaries misunderstand and say Our own hand has prevailed it was not the LORD who did all this

verses.original: כִּי־ ג֛וֹי אֹבַ֥ד עֵצ֖וֹת הֵ֑מָּה וְאֵ֥ין בָּהֶ֖ם תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḡō·w ’ō·ḇaḏ ‘ê·ṣō·wṯ hêm·māh wə·’ên bā·hem tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel with no understanding among them

verses.original: ל֥וּ חָכְמ֖וּ יַשְׂכִּ֣ילוּ זֹ֑את יָבִ֖ינוּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lū ḥā·ḵə·mū yaś·kî·lū zōṯ yā·ḇî·nū lə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯām
verses.literal: If only they were wise they would understand it they would comprehend their fate

verses.original: אֵיכָ֞ה יִרְדֹּ֤ף אֶחָד֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁנַ֖יִם יָנִ֣יסוּ רְבָבָ֑ה אִם־ לֹא֙ כִּי־ צוּרָ֣ם מְכָרָ֔ם וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִסְגִּירָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh yir·dōp̄ ’e·ḥāḏ ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·na·yim yā·nî·sū rə·ḇā·ḇāh ’im- lō kî- ṣū·rām mə·ḵā·rām Yah·weh his·gî·rām
verses.literal: How could one man pursue a thousand or two put ten thousand to flight unless . . . . . . their Rock had sold them unless the LORD had given them up

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א כְצוּרֵ֖נוּ צוּרָ֑ם וְאֹיְבֵ֖ינוּ פְּלִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō ḵə·ṣū·rê·nū ṣū·rām wə·’ō·yə·ḇê·nū pə·lî·lîm
verses.literal: For their rock is not like our Rock even our enemies concede

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִגֶּ֤פֶן סְדֹם֙ גַּפְנָ֔ם וּמִשַּׁדְמֹ֖ת עֲמֹרָ֑ה עֲנָבֵ֙מוֹ֙ עִנְּבֵי־ ר֔וֹשׁ אַשְׁכְּלֹ֥ת מְרֹרֹ֖ת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mig·ge·p̄en sə·ḏōm gap̄·nām ū·miš·šaḏ·mōṯ ‘ă·mō·rāh ‘ă·nā·ḇê·mōw ‘in·nə·ḇê- rō·wōš ’aš·kə·lōṯ mə·rō·rōṯ lā·mōw
verses.literal: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah Their grapes . . . are poisonous their clusters are bitter

verses.original: חֲמַ֥ת תַּנִּינִ֖ם יֵינָ֑ם וְרֹ֥אשׁ פְּתָנִ֖ים אַכְזָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·maṯ tan·nî·nim yê·nām wə·rōš pə·ṯā·nîm ’aḵ·zār
verses.literal: Their wine is the venom of serpents the deadly poison of cobras

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ ה֖וּא כָּמֻ֣ס עִמָּדִ֑י חָתֻ֖ם בְּאוֹצְרֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- hū kā·mus ‘im·mā·ḏî ḥā·ṯum bə·’ō·wṣ·rō·ṯāy
verses.literal: Have I not stored up these things sealed up within My vaults

verses.original: לִ֤י נָקָם֙ וְשִׁלֵּ֔ם לְעֵ֖ת תָּמ֣וּט רַגְלָ֑ם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם וְחָ֖שׁ עֲתִדֹ֥ת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lî nā·qām wə·šil·lêm lə·‘êṯ tā·mūṭ raḡ·lām kî qā·rō·wḇ yō·wm ’ê·ḏām wə·ḥāš ‘ă·ṯi·ḏōṯ lā·mōw
verses.literal: Vengeance is Mine I will repay In due time their foot will slip for their day of disaster is near and their doom is coming quickly

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָדִ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔וֹ וְעַל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו יִתְנֶחָ֑ם כִּ֤י יִרְאֶה֙ כִּי־ אָ֣זְלַת יָ֔ד וְאֶ֖פֶס עָצ֥וּר וְעָזֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·ḏîn Yah·weh ‘am·mōw wə·‘al- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yiṯ·ne·ḥām kî yir·’eh kî- ’ā·zə·laṯ yāḏ wə·’e·p̄es ‘ā·ṣūr wə·‘ā·zūḇ
verses.literal: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains slave or free

verses.original: וְאָמַ֖ר אֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ימוֹ צ֖וּר חָסָ֥יוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar ’ê ’ĕ·lō·hê·mōw ṣūr ḥā·sā·yū ḇōw
verses.literal: He will say Where are their gods the rock in which they took refuge

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵ֤לֶב זְבָחֵ֙ימוֹ֙ יֹאכֵ֔לוּ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ יֵ֣ין נְסִיכָ֑ם יָק֙וּמוּ֙ וְיַעְזְרֻכֶ֔ם יְהִ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם סִתְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥê·leḇ zə·ḇā·ḥê·mōw yō·ḵê·lū yiš·tū yên nə·sî·ḵām yā·qū·mū wə·ya‘·zə·ru·ḵem yə·hî ‘ă·lê·ḵem siṯ·rāh
verses.literal: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings Let them rise up and help you let them give you . . . shelter

verses.original: רְא֣וּ׀ עַתָּ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י אֲנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּדִ֑י אֲנִ֧י אָמִ֣ית וַאֲחַיֶּ֗ה מָחַ֙צְתִּי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶרְפָּ֔א וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū ‘at·tāh kî ’ă·nî ’ă·nî hū wə·’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·mā·ḏî ’ă·nî ’ā·mîṯ wa·’ă·ḥay·yeh mā·ḥaṣ·tî wa·’ă·nî ’er·pā wə·’ên mî·yā·ḏî maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: See now that I am He there is no God besides Me I bring death and I give life I wound . . . and I heal and there is no one who can deliver from My hand

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶל־ שָׁמַ֖יִם יָדִ֑י וְאָמַ֕רְתִּי חַ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’eś·śā ’el- šā·ma·yim yā·ḏî wə·’ā·mar·tî ḥay ’ā·nō·ḵî lə·‘ō·lām
verses.literal: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare As surely as I live forever

verses.original: אִם־ שַׁנּוֹתִי֙ בְּרַ֣ק חַרְבִּ֔י וְתֹאחֵ֥ז בְּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט יָדִ֑י אָשִׁ֤יב נָקָם֙ לְצָרָ֔י וְלִמְשַׂנְאַ֖י אֲשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- šan·nō·w·ṯî bə·raq ḥar·bî wə·ṯō·ḥêz bə·miš·pāṭ yā·ḏî ’ā·šîḇ nā·qām lə·ṣā·rāy wə·lim·śan·’ay ’ă·šal·lêm
verses.literal: when I sharpen My flashing sword and My hand grasps it in judgment I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me

verses.original: אַשְׁכִּ֤יר חִצַּי֙ מִדָּ֔ם וְחַרְבִּ֖י תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר מִדַּ֤ם חָלָל֙ וְשִׁבְיָ֔ה מֵרֹ֖אשׁ פַּרְע֥וֹת אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·kîr ḥiṣ·ṣay mid·dām wə·ḥar·bî tō·ḵal bā·śār mid·dam ḥā·lāl wə·šiḇ·yāh mê·rōš par·‘ō·wṯ ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: I will make My arrows drunk with blood while My sword devours flesh the blood of the slain and captives the heads of the enemy leaders

verses.original: הַרְנִ֤ינוּ גוֹיִם֙ עַמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י דַם־ עֲבָדָ֖יו יִקּ֑וֹם וְנָקָם֙ יָשִׁ֣יב לְצָרָ֔יו וְכִפֶּ֥ר אַדְמָת֖וֹ עַמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: har·nî·nū ḡō·w·yim ‘am·mōw kî ḏam- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw yiq·qō·wm wə·nā·qām yā·šîḇ lə·ṣā·rāw wə·ḵip·per ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw ‘am·mōw
verses.literal:
Rejoice, O heavens, with Him,

and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations with His people for He will avenge the blood of His children He will take vengeance on His adversaries

and repay those who hate Him He will cleanse His land and His people

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַשִּׁירָֽה־ הַזֹּ֖את בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh way·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê haš·šî·rāh- haz·zōṯ bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām hū wə·hō·wō·šê·a‘ bin- nūn
verses.literal: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people . . .

verses.original: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵal mō·šeh lə·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ שִׂ֣ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם לְכָל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵעִ֥יד בָּכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תְּצַוֻּם֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁמֹ֣ר לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem śî·mū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem lə·ḵāl had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·‘îḏ bā·ḵem hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer tə·ṣaw·wum ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem liš·mōr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: he said to them Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ דָבָ֨ר רֵ֥ק הוּא֙ מִכֶּ֔ם כִּי־ ה֖וּא חַיֵּיכֶ֑ם וּבַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî lō- ḏā·ḇār rêq hū mik·kem kî- hū ḥay·yê·ḵem ū·ḇad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ta·’ă·rî·ḵū yā·mîm ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên šām·māh lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: For they are not idle words to you because they are your life . . . and by them you will live long . . . in the land that you are crossing the Jordan . . . to possess

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּעֶ֛צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: On that . . . same day the LORD said to Moses

verses.original: עֲלֵ֡ה אֶל־ הַר֩ הָעֲבָרִ֨ים הַזֶּ֜ה הַר־ נְב֗וֹ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַאֲחֻזָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lêh ’el- har hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm haz·zeh har- nə·ḇōw ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê yə·rê·ḥōw ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh
verses.literal: Go up into the Abarim Range . . . to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab across from Jericho and view the land of Canaan which I am giving to the Israelites . . . as their own possession

verses.original: וּמֻ֗ת בָּהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עֹלֶ֣ה שָׁ֔מָּה וְהֵאָסֵ֖ף אֶל־ עַמֶּ֑יךָ כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ מֵ֞ת אַהֲרֹ֤ן אָחִ֙יךָ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־ עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·muṯ bā·hār ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·leh šām·māh wə·hê·’ā·sêp̄ ’el- ‘am·me·ḵā ka·’ă·šer- mêṯ ’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā bə·hōr hā·hār way·yê·’ā·sep̄ ’el- ‘am·māw
verses.literal: And there on the mountain that you climb you will die and be gathered to your people just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people

verses.original: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מְעַלְתֶּ֜ם בִּ֗י בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּמֵֽי־ מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־ צִ֑ן עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אוֹתִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ’ă·šer mə·‘al·tem bî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·mê- mə·rî·ḇaṯ qā·ḏêš miḏ·bar- ṣin ‘al ’ă·šer lō- qid·daš·tem ’ō·w·ṯî bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh . . . in the Wilderness of Zin both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites . . . by failing to treat Me as holy in their . . . presence

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִנֶּ֖גֶד תִּרְאֶ֣ה אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תָב֔וֹא אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî min·ne·ḡeḏ tir·’eh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šām·māh lō ṯā·ḇō·w ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî nō·ṯên liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites . . . you shall not enter it . . . . . .
